where the digital game had to decide

All 40 weapon cards (power, range, ammo, uses, throws, absorb, CF per hit, soul steal, both attacks); one card of each in the market, class weapons pulled out for the gladiators in play, and the level 4 Labrys, Psykhe and Shield of Achilles in the Arena Chest.

The full 70-card arena deck and the 12 round-2 cards, the 15 Mandata Flavi, the 12 Carmina verses, the 8 class cards, the 13 Summa Rudis event cards and the 12 Fates. Hover any card name or thumbnail to see the card.

Commodus' entrance damage goes to the location every gladiator can best afford. Lure and Rete use range 4 from the thrower. Herculean Vigor applies to your next attack. "A generous applause" is flavor.

The Naumachia water tokens now use the printed set (water tiles, crocodiles, sunken Level 1–3 weapons and armor, and +2/+3 AP Armor Upgrades; 16 drawn face-down), and the chariot horses (Palmatus, Ocianus, Saxo, Vindex), wheels (Wagon, Laurel, Gilded) and chariot names use the printed token stats. The 36 Blessings tokens remain an estimated mix.
Naumachia teams take turns one gladiator at a time (grouped by team) rather than moving simultaneously. Festival and missio events always use CPU opponents for the empty seats.

✏️ One sculptor, every designer. The Token Designer’s shape bench — add, click or drag on the preview (it keeps your grip), nudge, bring forward / send back, duplicate, delete, color, outline, width, height, rotation, opacity, 🔨 Commit (bake) and Unbake — is now the very same bench in the Token Designer, the Weapon forge, the Armor forge, the Trophy designer and the Banner press. Baked shapes are drawn under the live ones and saved with the piece.

⬜ Blank canvases. New weapons, armor pieces, trophies and banners start empty, on a gridded canvas. A Start from… picker still offers every printed silhouette, casting and heraldic device as a template. Characters and beasts keep their bodies.

⚔ The Weapon forge, weapon first. The weapon itself is drawn large, upright, and sculpted there; its printed-style card is generated from it underneath — the same arrangement as the character creator’s portrait and token.

🛡 Armor on the body. Toggle On the avatar to see the piece on the blank player avatar: drag it into place, size it, and click a body zone (head, chest, arm, leg) to choose where it equips. A fitted piece is worn on your player-board avatar in play (mirrored on the left side).

🎟 Spectating is back — everywhere. In Play now, with every seat CPU, Play as a spectator seats you in the stands before the horns (the crowd is filled in if you had none). During any match with no fighter of yours standing — none entered, or yours has fallen — 🎟 Buy a ticket seats you mid-bout, paid from the active wallet (general admission 4 coin, not counted as betting). Each rotation you earn 1 CF and may throw stones or offerings, change sections or join a chant for Tholo.

🏛 Manager mode. Every Match Week bout, special heat and the Superbus has a 🎟 Spectate button: the ticket comes from your treasury, priced by the billing (Undercard 3 · Feature 6 · Main event 12 · a special 10 · the Superbus 20). Everything is allowed — but noticed: each offering to your own fighter, or stone at their rivals, costs your house 1 fame, at most 3 a bout. Whether a career may spectate is a house rule chosen at the founding (on by default).

🦅 The show goes on. On the main menu, after the Damnatio is hauled off, the base beasts come for the rest: the eagle drops from above, the bear rises from behind, wolves and snakes come in from the front, and Tholo reaches out of the shadows. With the sand empty, Commodus strides in and raises his sword as laurels and flowers rain at his feet — and now and then a gladiator comes back, fights him in a cloud of dust, and kneels over his body.
